evidence_quotes.O: I have been an avid user of Wacom products for almost a decade now and for digital artwork, I still use my Intuous 3 Graphic Tablet.
evidence_quotes.C: These do take two AAA batteries each, so as always with my electronic equipment, attached the Eneloop batteries and they work perfectly.
evidence_quotes.E: Because I travel and cover so many events and there are times where our photographers are busy covering things, I figured...It would be great to have a DSLR.
evidence_quotes.A: I figured that I can help others out there to decide if this 5-and-1 device is for you or not.
evidence_quotes.N: At $36-$40, you can't really complain (note: The two shown on Amazon are the same product)...but here is my experience which varies from others...
